name: Seal of Fury
tooltip:
Seal of Fury
Level 60
60 Mana
Instant
Requires Paladin
Requires level 18
Fills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to inflict an additional 9 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 48 to 52 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.
